actor_id.description: Gitea user id of the actor.

actor_login.description: Actor login, denormalized so deleting the user from Gitea does not erase who deployed (E5).

branch.description: Branch, when the run was not dispatched against a tag.

created_unix.description: When the row was appended, unix seconds.

occurred_unix.description: When it happened, UTC unix seconds.

run_id.description: Gitea's own Actions run id, the evidence for the event.

audit.description: The run's audit events, when ?expand=audit was asked for (I9).

branch.description: Branch, when the run was not dispatched against a tag.

created_unix.description: When the row was appended, unix seconds.

release.description: The release, when ?expand=release was asked for (I9).

release_tag.description: Release tag deployed. Releases own version identity; no version string is parsed (D1).

status.description: Run status at the moment the deployment was first recorded. Written once, never updated: the current state of a cell is projected from the audit log (E3, E5).

approval_policy.description: Approval policy. Defaults to none, so adding the fork changes no existing behaviour.

repo_id.description: Repository the environment belongs to; 0 is the instance-wide default set.

required_approvals.description: Approvals a held deploy needs. Defaults to 1.

sort_order.description: Render order. Order is configuration; the model expresses no sequence.

accepted.description: What the endpoint would have accepted instead.

parameter.description: The offending parameter, when the rejection names one.

suggested_action.description: What to do about it. Every error carries one (A21).

cells.description: One cell per environment, in configured order (E7). Each carries environment, state, symbol, successes, run_id, run_url and occurred_unix; a cell opens its run (E8).

release_url.description: Link to the release; a release row opens the release (E8).

deployments.description: Deployments of this release, when ?expand=deployments was asked for (I9).

is_prerelease.description: Whether the release is marked as a prerelease.

tag_name.description: Release tag, the identity a deployment points at (D1).

target.description: The release's own commitish. The deploy job posts its commit status against this SHA (D2).

environment.description: Environment the secret is scoped to; empty means unscoped.

name.description: Secret name. A secret VALUE is never readable over any endpoint at any scope (I12).

scoped.description: Whether an environment scope is configured for this secret.

info.description: The fork's own namespace. Every view is a client of an endpoint here (E18, I14); Gitea's swagger group at /api/v1 is untouched (F3, I15).
info.title: Gitea delivery API

get.description: One row per event, retained indefinitely; no purge or archive path exists (E5, E13). actor_login is denormalized, so deleting the user from Gitea does not erase who deployed. The resource is read-only: no POST, PATCH or DELETE is published (I11). Pages by cursor; the continuation token is in the X-Next-Cursor header and in Link rel=next (I6).
